$comment: discipline-pack config for temp-redmine (Ruby/Rails). Every section is optional — hooks no-op when their section is missing.
$commentRubocop: No Ruby/Bundler on this machine (checked PATH, WSL, nothing installed) — dod-gate and format-postcheck run rubocop via the standalone image built from .claude/rubocop-docker/Dockerfile (rubocop 1.91.0 / rubocop-performance 1.27.0 / rubocop-rails 2.37.0, pinned to this repo's Gemfile test group). Build once: `docker build -t discipline-pack-rubocop:local -f .claude/rubocop-docker/Dockerfile .claude/rubocop-docker`. .claude/rubocop-docker/overrides.yml layers on top of the repo's .rubocop.yml to set Layout/EndOfLine to crlf — this host's global core.autocrlf=true checks files out as CRLF even though the repo's canonical (committed) line ending is LF, and rubocop's Linux-container 'native' style is LF, so without the override every file would falsely fail on line endings alone.

dod.$comment: Full rake test is far too slow for a 60s Stop hook on a 174k-LOC app — rubocop is the fast gate; run rake test yourself before pushing. A full-repo dockerized rubocop run measured ~47s here, so the Stop hook's timeout is raised to 120s in settings.json for headroom.
